name: MUZIKAZ Live Firing Range
label: Live multiplayer tournament range
description: Permanent shared firing range with server-scored multiplayer tournaments, timed challenges, moving targets, lane selection, adjustable scopes and a live competition board. Practice, compete or spectate from the safe firing-line lobby.

name: Pixel Peaks Ski Resort
label: Mountain skiing · lifts · château
description: A massive 1.2 km alpine resort with a 300 m natural summit and 180 m ski vertical, four color-coded ski trails, two rideable chairlifts, three snow ramps, woodland trails, warming hut and a walk-in château with a glowing fireplace, lounge, dining room, stairs and observation balcony. Smooth multiplayer skiing with easy steering, ordered race gates, jump points, timed finishes, medals and shared leaderboards. Wide boarding lanes and complete lift rides with automatic summit exits.

name: MUZIKAZ International Airport
label: Public flight and airport experience
description: A brick-built public airport with three flyable aircraft, three connected airfields across expanded airspace, automatic destination flights, taxiways, terminal, hangar, control tower, radio captions and optional spoken ATC, mobile flight controls and ground services.

dialogueSettings.text: Board with E / Use. Request Tower takeoff clearance from the radio SVG. W / left stick taxis and accelerates, A/D steer, Space or Climb rises, Shift or Descend lowers. Brake with S. Exit only after landing.
